name: AUDRA 4 PERSON CANOPY BARREL SAUNA
description: The Audra 4-Person Barrel Sauna simply designed and highly effective, providing maximum usable space while minimizing excess cubic feet. This allows for the sauna to heat quickly and efficiently. This model is available in rustic fir, rustic cedar, and clear cedar and is designed with a tempered glass door. The front wall section is set back to enhance the look of the sauna with a functional and decorative porch. This is lovely for setting your towels or cold drinks outside of the sauna or for taking a cooling off break.
